<script>
// Count papers in each category
function countPapers() {
  // Conference papers count
  fetch('conference/index.html')
    .then(res => res.text())
    .then(html => {
      const count = (html.match(/paper-card/g) || []).length - 1; // Subtract empty state
      document.getElementById('conf-count').textContent = count + ' papers';
    });
  
  // Journal papers count (currently 0)
  document.getElementById('journal-count').textContent = '0 papers';
  
  // White papers count (currently 0)
  document.getElementById('whitepaper-count').textContent = '0 papers';
}

// Load featured papers
function loadFeaturedPapers() {
  const featured = [
    {
      title: 'From Notes to Knowledge: Designing an AI Wiki Companion for Learner-in-the-Loop Knowledge Construction',
      type: 'conference',
      venue: 'LAK/AIED 2027',
      authors: 'Research Team, AI Education Research',
      year: '2026',
      link: 'conference/ai-wiki-companion-2026.html'
    }
  ];
  
  document.getElementById('featured-papers').innerHTML = featured.map(paper => `
    <div class="featured-card">
      <div class="featured-badge featured-${paper.type}">${paper.type.toUpperCase()}</div>
      <h3 class="featured-title">${paper.title}</h3>
      <p class="featured-authors">${paper.authors}</p>
      <div class="featured-meta">
        <span class="featured-venue">${paper.venue}</span>
        <span class="featured-year">${paper.year}</span>
      </div>
      <a href="${paper.link}" class="btn primary">View Paper</a>
    </div>
  `).join('');
}

countPapers();
loadFeaturedPapers();
</script>
